summary: First-run end-to-end testing of Tanmay Visuals cinematic portfolio + admin panel. Ran 13 pytest cases against the deployed backend (100% pass) covering /api/, /api/contact (validation + admin persistence), /api/analytics/event, /api/analytics/summary (401 + admin), /api/contacts (admin), /api/admin/verify (bad + good key), and full work-items CRUD (public GET, admin POST/DELETE, 401 for unauth, 404 for missing). Ran Playwright UI tests on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) plus /admin route. Homepage loads without JS errors, hero portrait renders, hero-lets-talk & bottom-nav-cta have correct wa.me/919266553033 target=_blank href, hero-see-work scrolls to #work, contact form validates empty submit (contact-error) and posts successfully (contact-success), admin route rejects wrong key with 'Invalid admin key.' and unlocks with tanmay-admin-2026 showing work items + Leads sections. Adding a work item via admin form persists and appears on '/' after refresh.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile menu links inside nav-mobile-menu do NOT carry data-testid=nav-work/nav-services/nav-about/nav-contact. Only the (hidden on mobile) desktop nav has those testids. This makes automated tests of mobile nav links impossible via the documented data-testids. The links themselves are visible and functional.

issues: Fixed BottomNav 'Let's Talk' pill overlaps the form 'Send message' button when the form is scrolled into view — see screenshot. Consider hiding BottomNav when #contact is in viewport, or increasing form bottom padding.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add data-testid="nav-work/services/about/contact" to the mobile menu <motion.a> entries in Navbar.jsx (currently only on the hidden md:flex desktop nav).
OPTIONAL: Hide/dim BottomNav when the contact section is in viewport to avoid overlapping the 'Send message' button.

Console warnings from framer-motion useScroll about ref not yet hydrated / non-static container appear on load — harmless but noisy. Consider moving useScroll into the same component as the ref or adding position:relative to the container.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py properly excludes MongoDB _id in reads (projection {'_id':0}) and uses UUID string ids — good.
Contact form still succeeds when RESEND_API_KEY is empty (email_sent=false) as required — verified in test.
Admin auth uses X-Admin-Key header consistently across endpoints; frontend AdminPanel stores key in sessionStorage which is acceptable for this preview build.
Backend server.py ~230 lines, clean and cohesive; no need to split.
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (via lib/track.js API export) — no hardcoded URLs.
trackEvent silently swallows errors so analytics failures cannot break UX — good.
Contact create response uses ContactOut which uses ConfigDict(extra='ignore') to drop ip/user_agent from response — good privacy.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of documented flows (1 minor testability gap on mobile nav testids)

test_credentials: Admin key: tanmay-admin-2026 (env ADMIN_KEY). RESEND_API_KEY intentionally empty.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed contacts and work items via API and admin UI. Left one legacy TEST_ work item was cleaned up post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Admin key header is X-Admin-Key (case-insensitive on server). Mobile nav-mobile-menu links do not currently have data-testids — if a future task adds them, retest by opening nav-mobile-toggle then querying [data-testid=nav-work] etc. BottomNav is fixed and z-50, may overlap centered form buttons; expected but design gap.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. The mobile nav testid gap is because Navbar.jsx renders two separate link sets (desktop <nav> with data-testids at lines 51-62, mobile <motion.div data-testid="nav-mobile-menu"> with plain <motion.a> at lines 100-112 lacking data-testid attributes). The BottomNav/Send overlap is a z-index layering choice — bottom-nav is z-50, form button is not fixed.
